name: Kozuka Akira
source:
A young man who loves [url=/c85105]Shoutarou[/url]. Sometimes a bit too scary. Suddenly disappears every time the hero siren can be heard. Looks like a straightforward and nice young man, but is actually full of mystery. His occupation is a manga artist and his dream is to buy his own home.

[Based on the [Url=https://adeltaz1.wixsite.com/uuultrac/blank-8]official description[/url]]

[Spoiler]He's an (in)famous guro manga artist who goes by the name of V-Jack. 

DOB: 09.11.1950
Real name: unknown.
Nationality: unknown.[/spoiler]
